candidates.name: SATIR
candidates.detail: Label "H01 / SATIR". Radical editorial BORDERLESS transcript. All messages are plain text directly on desktop, no filled containers anywhere. Every user message starts with tiny muted label "Sen", indented at left in lightgray, text below in #B5B6BE. Assistant text aligns on common left baseline, bright #F2F1F5 regular weight, with a fine short lavender vertical rule only beside each assistant answer. Long answer is three clean airy text lines. Thin hairline separator between each user-assistant exchange, not around messages. Composer is borderless text entry with ONLY a short 1px muted-gray underline and a lavender caret, small plain arrow right. Orb left of input. Reading-first typographic layout, like elegant floating text, not code terminal. Don't use >_ or mono font. No pills or cards.

Last message reads as a useful answer rather than chat chrome.
